lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five discernible vertical columns on the mid-flank, transitioning into a higher-density, stochastic distribution of smaller clusters toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a grid-like structure, most prominent in the anterior-to-mid section of the visible lateral field.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel linear features extend horizontally across the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with high-value pixels on the dorsal aspect and lower-value shadow pixels on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of small, high-luminance blobs is present on the visible dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger, more spaced clusters on the primary flank.
